Sources of the files in this folder.

- `*-captured.sse`: answers of chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses to the `.request.json` next to them, captured through the Portboard proxy on 2026-11-24, `safety_identifier` and `prompt_cache_key` replaced.
- `request-*.json`: Claude Code 2.1.330 request shape captured on 2026-11-24, text replaced.
- Other files: hand-written. The `*.expected.json` files are what `src/core/accounts/gpt.ts` must produce for the file of the same name.
